raw.rationale: This compound is a launched histamine H2-receptor antagonist (likely famotidine/cimetidine-class) with no known cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 µM; PRISM viability effects would be minimal and non-selective, so lineage-selective killing probabilities are near the low base rate. SLC47A1/MATE1 and SLC29A4 interactions could modestly alter intracellular exposure in transporter-high lineages, but not enough to produce selective lethality.
